title: Algorithm-Guided Intraoperative Propofol Prediction in Target-Controlled Infusion: A Prospective Randomised Study for Personalised Waste Reduction
summary: By providing a forecast of the required propofol amount for the remaining operating time, we enable the anaesthetist to prepare smaller injections and thus reduce wastage. The anaesthetist remains responsible for the anaesthesia management.

interventions.name: Intraoperative propofol consumption prediction for remaining duration of surgery

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
- Qualified medical staff specialising in anaesthesiology (junior doctors, specialist doctors, senior doctors)
- Operating theatre support for total intravenous anaesthesia
Exclusion criteria:
• Rejection
